name: InputBindSlot
meaning: slot of an InputMgr binding table (InputMgr.keyTable / padTable, 16 {device, button} pairs; verified in InputMgr::Poll and BindMenuKey). Slots 0..11 are the PS1 buttons Poll turns into the active-low pad word, slots 12..15 the menu directions (keyboard only, also the keyboard's axis keys). Not the g_inputMap slots (InputMapSlot)

name: INPUT_BIND_MENU_UP
meaning: menu up: BindMenuKey also makes it the keyboard's Y- axis key (KB_AXIS_Y_NEG)

name: INPUT_BIND_MENU_RIGHT
meaning: menu right: the keyboard's X+ axis key (KB_AXIS_X_POS)

name: INPUT_BIND_MENU_DOWN
meaning: menu down: the keyboard's Y+ axis key (KB_AXIS_Y_POS)

name: INPUT_BIND_MENU_LEFT
meaning: menu left: the keyboard's X- axis key (KB_AXIS_X_NEG)
